history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration conduct a comprehensive cost analysis of the services provided to calculate the updated total cost of ownership and to align the relevant cost recovery with the appropriate and reasonable charges.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Office of Information and Communications Technology has undertaken a structured and data- driven review of its services, cost of ownership and cost recovery methodology. A critical preliminary activity involved the definition and categorization of core ICT services, clearly delineated based on their function, scope and the resources required for their delivery. Service bundles were developed to reflect the distinct needs and usage patterns of different user populations, namely United Nations Headquarters, field missions and others (non-field/ away from Headquarters). The pricing model took into account the distinction between regular budget and support account assessed resources, allowing identification of the remaining funding gap to be addressed through cost recovery revenue. In line with the cost-recovery policy and guidelines issued by the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget, the cost recovery rates were calculated to reflect only the recoverable portion of each ICT service or bundle. Rates were derived by dividing the total recoverable cost of each service by the number of Microsoft 365 users confirmed at the time of rate development. This approach ensures a fair, transparent and user-centric distribution of costs across the relevant populations, improving the accuracy of cost attribution. The rates have been operationalized with the setup of the activity codes in Umoja to allow the Office of Information and Communications Technology to exercise cost recovery. The activity codes are approved by the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget, which constitutes its endorsement of the services and related pricing model now in place.
history.board_assessment: Given that the new related pricing model is now in place, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
